decision: Owner decision #39 (2026-11-08): limited CLAUDE.md §9 exception for the non-official experiment Worker (P0-A2 phase 3, #156); Owner SAVE requirement (2026-11-08): minimal exception for local IndexedDB saves of non-official experiment worlds
label_zh: 非正式實驗世界／不屬於正式遊戲歷史

experimental_save_store.rule: Only these files may touch IndexedDB / StorageManager / Web Locks, only for databases whose name starts with the prefix, and only to store non-official experiment-world snapshots received from the Worker. They import only ./ viewer modules, never fetch or write anything else, and never touch saves/ or journal/.

how_to_extend: Adding an allowed prefix (e.g. a new pure P0-A2 module) is a rules change: edit this file in its own PR, list the module's purity checks, and pass Codex fixed-SHA review before the Worker may import it.
